answer.generated: Vertical partitioning distributes attributes across different entities, allowing efficient retrieval of large datasets with a single access by concentrating related information. In contrast, horizontal partitioning splits tuples among entities, which may require multiple accesses to gather all relevant data. This approach reduces the number of separate database accesses needed for complex queries, improving performance in distributed systems where data is spread across nodes.
